title.en: Cleusio Castro brings Angolan experience, titles and BAL pedigree
title.es: Cleusio Castro aporta experiencia angoleña, títulos y recorrido BAL

summary.en: Angolan forward/center Cleusio Castro continues to stand out as an experienced international profile. At 2.00 m, with Petro de Luanda and Angola national-team exposure, his pathway combines competitiveness, continental experience and proven impact in high-level African basketball.
summary.es: El interior angoleño Cleusio Castro sigue destacando como un perfil internacional con experiencia. Con 2,00 m, recorrido en Petro de Luanda y presencia con la selección de Angola, su trayectoria combina competitividad, experiencia continental e impacto probado en el baloncesto africano de alto nivel.

evidence.why_relevant: Official BAL coverage confirms Petro de Luanda's repeated BAL Finals presence and highlights a key Cleusio Castro play in the 2026 semifinal. FIBA also confirms his Angola national-team profile and Petro de Luanda club context.
